verdict.rationale: Superset documents a prompt-first flow where you describe a task, pick a coding agent, and the agent starts working in an isolated worktree. You then review its changes in the diff viewer and commit, push, and create a PR. The actual implementation is done by the third-party CLI agents Superset hosts, and nothing in the evidence addresses test writing. Missing for 10: any evidence of agents writing or running tests, evidence that Superset itself (not the hosted agent) drives feature implementation to completion, and independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end feature delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent implement a requested feature end-to-end, including writing tests

citations.quote: In the prompt-first flow, describe the task, pick an agent, and create. The agent starts working on your prompt immediately.
